name: progress-e2e-pty-darwin-only
body: pty_output is the BSD/darwin `script -q /dev/null <cmd> <args>` form only; util-linux script needs `script -q -c '<cmd>' /dev/null`, so the four pty-based progress e2e tests would fail on Linux. Upgrade when the e2e tier must run on Linux CI: add a cfg(target_os = "linux") -c branch.
